control.title: CERT-In reporting within 6 hours
control.description: Report reportable cyber incidents to CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing them, using the prescribed format, and keep proof of submission.

implementation_notes: Covered by the incident response plan; CERT-In POC registered.
evidence_hint: Incident records with CERT-In report timestamps.
acceptance_criteria: Incident records show when the incident was noticed
Reportable incidents show a CERT-In report within 6 hours, or the plan defines this step and the PoC

requirements.title: Report cyber incidents within 6 hours
requirements.guidance: Report the cyber incident types listed in Annexure I to CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing them or being notified of them.

requirements.title: Report incidents to RBI within 6 hours
requirements.guidance: A Board-approved incident response mechanism with forensics; report incidents to RBI in the Annex 1 format within 6 hours of detection, and to CERT-In.

requirements.title: Incident response
requirements.guidance: Respond to incidents with a defined programme to contain, remediate and communicate.

requirements.title: Response to information security incidents
requirements.guidance: Respond to incidents according to documented procedures.
